name: stackd-minimalist
description: Stack'd — a minimalist todo PWA, wrapped with Capacitor for iOS/Android.

scripts.check: node scripts/check-dates.mjs && node scripts/check-reminders.mjs && node scripts/check-store.mjs && node scripts/check-shell.mjs && node scripts/check-bundle.mjs
scripts.ios: npm run build && cap sync ios && cap open ios
scripts.android: npm run build && cap sync android && cap open android
